title: AAPS 3.3.0: Main Menu Button CGM no longer visible/nor activates DiaKEM DEX G7 App (BYODA)
symptom: With AAPS 3.3.0, the CGM button on the main screen is no longer visible or does not activate the DiaKEM Dexcom G7 app, even though it can still be activated in AAPS config. Previously, pressing it would open the DiaKEM Dexcom G7 app directly.
cause: The issue is impossible for Android 11.
fix: The issue was resolved in AAPS 3.3.1.1, and it works perfectly with Android 15.
